role: Zone 1, where the player lands. Wide open meadow, great beasts roaming, herbs to pick, dung for fertilizer. The forest edge at its north side is the boundary into Zone 2, and per DEC-0027 that treeline is what HIDES the camp.
note_on_origin: Matches SM_LandingCircle at (-18, 0) and the existing ZONE 1 layout in GROK_IMAGINE_PROMPTS.md 1B, so the field prompt and this spec agree. Zone 1 sits south of the camp zone at z -95.

ground_cover.read: long flowing grass, waist-to-chest on a 1.8 m adult
ground_cover.why_the_height_is_a_mechanic_not_a_decor: At 1.1 m the grass hides a 0.15 m dung pile. That is deliberate - the Lead said the player 'will roam around and find herbs... and dung'. Roaming only means something if something can be missed. Grass this tall also means a great beast at 2.2 m reads above the grass line while a human-sized animal would not, which is what makes 'great' legible without a label.
ground_cover.flattened_on_path: 0.35 m along SM_Path_Field - the trodden path is how you navigate and the grass height is the way you read it

materials.note: Only if Q24 resolves toward a tended garden. M_Nurtured exists and RES_SEED exists; the soil state is what is undecided, not the material.

master_binding_note: First pass at these five slots named M_GrassField, M_FurBeast, M_LeafHerb and M_BarkPine - none of which exist. The ten masters are M_StylizedGrass, M_CliffRock, M_WoodCabin, M_WoodWild, M_FoliageCard, M_PathStone, M_GatherHerb, M_BeastStylized, M_SpiritUnlit, M_Nurtured. Caught by test_zone_specs_name_only_canon_masters, which is the same failure as M_FamilySilhouette and M_ValleyNight earlier in the pipeline. Inventing plausible-looking material names is the exact habit that check exists to stop.

treeline.name: SM_Treeline_Forest
treeline.function: OPAQUE SIGHTLINE BLOCKER - this is the whole point of it
treeline.requirement: From ANY point in the open meadow, the forest interior must be completely hidden. No gap, no thinner patch, no visible path, no clearing. This is what makes the fixed camp discoverable on approach instead of visible from the landing circle (DEC-0027).
treeline.how_to_verify: Stand the camera at SM_LandingCircle (-18, 0) at 1.7 m and confirm zero forest interior is visible. Then again from (+20, -15). If any ground or the camp itself is visible from either, DEC-0027 has failed and the camp placement answer needs revisiting.
treeline.caveat: Ten-metre pines with a closed canopy. The block is free at this scale, but it only works if the canopy actually closes - gaps are the failure mode, not height.

gap_fertilizer.status: RESOLVED 2026-10-02 - Q24 answered by the Lead, and it was not about fertilizer
gap_fertilizer.the_question_asked: Can a SPIRIT apply fertilizer at night? Night is spirit form, so 'during the night-time' might mean as a spirit.
gap_fertilizer.the_answer: 'Gather by day, tend by night will be the theme throughout the game.'
gap_fertilizer.what_it_actually_settled: V2b in VISION_BOARD - a principle for the whole game, not a crafting verb. Night is for TENDING, and tending includes soil, sleeping guards and a captive. The same gesture in both places: you make it possible for something to rest.
gap_fertilizer.why_res_seed: Compost is the seed resource's natural sibling, so this adds NO seventh resource and the locked six-resource inventory is intact. Adding RES_DUNG would have broken it. Applying dung moves a garden bed's soil state, rendered with the existing M_Nurtured master - both of which already existed with nothing pointing at them.
gap_fertilizer.what_it_left_unwritten: THE SINGLE MOST LOAD-BEARING UNWRITTEN RULE IN THE PROTOTYPE: what may a spirit TOUCH? Soil, yes. A rope, to free the captive? A sleeping guard? Both the garden and the camp rescue depend on the answer, and it does not exist in Source/. Recorded rather than guessed.
gap_fertilizer.secondary_risk: Night is now mandatory for homestead progress - if tending only happens at night, a player who cannot reach spirit form cannot advance the garden at all. That is a strong dependency on M11 (bed AND rune) and needs a fallback or an explicit, legible failure.

measured_note: DELIBERATELY NULL. Nothing here is built. Every size is authored from the 1.8 m adult reference and tagged 'authored, not built'. A reader run will report FIELD as MISSING, which is the correct report.
open_questions: Q15, still parked: the field is 60 x 40 m here, matching the existing 1B prompt. The camp clearing's size is still unsettled (~84 m or smaller) and the two need to agree at the treeline.

Does the grass sway? 'Swaying in the breeze' is atmosphere, not geometry, and it needs a wind or vertex-animation system that does not exist. Recorded as atmosphere, not a must - but if it is load-bearing for the feel of the field, it is a new system.
Two great beasts or a herd? Two is authored. 'Great beasts roaming' implies more than two, and a herd reads as a population rather than as two set pieces.
